name: levnikolaevich-skills-marketplace
description: Standalone skills for Claude Code and Codex: product discovery, architecture, implementation, technical foundations, reviews and delivery, with explicit scope and verification.

plugins.name: product-discovery-suite
plugins.description: Decide what is worth building, who it serves, and what a useful first version must do.

plugins.name: architecture-suite
plugins.description: Understand the system you have and choose changes with clear boundaries, tradeoffs, and recovery paths.

plugins.name: delivery-planning-suite
plugins.description: Find missing decisions and risky dependencies before they become implementation rework.

plugins.name: implementation-suite
plugins.description: Fix the cause, reuse what already works, and keep changes focused on a verified outcome.

plugins.name: quality-assurance-suite
plugins.description: Find gaps that could break a release, mislead a maintainer, or make a passing test meaningless.

plugins.name: delivery-suite
plugins.description: Publish the intended changes and verify what reached the remote repository or target environment.

plugins.name: operations-suite
plugins.description: Turn incidents and product signals into evidence for the next recovery or product decision.

plugins.name: skill-maintenance-suite
plugins.description: Make skills easier to invoke correctly, follow consistently, and verify before distribution.

plugins.name: engineering-foundation-suite
plugins.description: Establish and verify project technical foundations using native stack mechanisms, explicit contracts and safe recovery.
